shared_elements: bared teeth / mouth rendered as a row of squares (A) vs. animal jaws (B)
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces present schematic zoomorphic/anthropomorphic imagery, and both place a creature-like form above a head-like mass (a coiled, segmented crest crowning the sculpted face in A; animals ranged above the broad head-like slab in B). Otherwise the depicted content differs sharply: A is a single three-dimensional grimacing head with a gridded row of teeth and no scene, while B is a vertical stack of low-relief profile animals (quadrupeds, a long-necked bird) separated by banded registers and abstract signs.
